=From the provided {{ $json.data }}, extract and present the following information in bullet points under the title "Data Breach Snapshot". Use the exact format shown below.
 
Instructions:
 
Bold only the field titles. The values should remain unbolded.
 
If any PDF links are present and related to the breach, check them for relevant information to fill in the fields below.
 
If data is missing for a required field, follow the fallback instructions provided.
 
Field Details to Extract:
 
Entity Name: Name of the organization that experienced the breach.
 
Headquarters: City and State of the organization. Perform a web search if this information is not found in the data.
 
# Impacted: Number of individuals affected. If not specified, enter not-specified.
 
Public Disclosure Date: Date the breach was disclosed to the Attorney General or U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS). If not available, enter NA.
 
Information Compromised: List the types of personal data affected (e.g., Names, SSN, DOB), separated by commas.
 
Link to Where I Found Out About the Breach: Include the original source URL from the input data.
 
Link to Public Disclosure (AG site/official source): Include the official breach disclosure link (e.g., AG site, HHS portal). Check any attached PDF for this information as well.
 
Company URL: The official website of the breached entity. Search the web if not available in the input.
 
Date Notice Letters Went Out: Date when notice letters were sent. Check PDFs for this date. If not available, enter NA.
 
Notice Link: Provide the URL to the notice letter, if available. Otherwise, enter NA.
 
Tier: Determine the tier based on the number of impacted individuals: Tier 1 if 500,000 or more individuals impacted. Tier 2 if fewer than 500,000 impacted, or not specified

Lead_Probability:Set values using these  3 rules:
- Notice_Letters = "Yes" if any notice/PDF/link/email/letter exists, else "No".
- Impacted = "Known" if any number of affected people appears, else "Unknown".
- Company_Type = "B2C" if serving consumers, "B2B" if serving businesses.

Then compute Lead_Probability using:
IF(Notice_Letters="Yes", IF(Impacted="Known", IF(Company_Type="B2C","High","Moderate"), IF(Company_Type="B2C","Moderate","Low")), IF(Impacted="Known", IF(Company_Type="B2C","Moderate","Low"), "Low"))


Ad_Status:"No" if Link to Where I Found Out About the Breach is from  Maine otherwise set it to "Yes".
Present the extracted data in this exact structured snapshot format:
 
Data Breach Snapshot
 
Entity Name:
 
Headquarters:
 
# Impacted:
 
Public Disclosure Date:
 
Information Compromised: (Present this as comma separated)
 
Link to Where I Found Out About the Breach:
 
Link to Public Disclosure (AG site/official source):
 
Company URL:
 
Date Notice Letters Went Out:
 
Notice Link:
 
Tier:

Lead_Probability:

Ad_Status:
